description: This file defines the 'SheetView' class, which manages different view settings for an Excel worksheet in PhpSpreadsheet. It includes constants for view types, properties for zoom levels and visibility options, and methods to get and set these properties, including validation logic.

classes.name: SheetView
classes.description: A class representing the view settings for an Excel worksheet, including view type, zoom levels, and zero display options.

methods.name: getZoomScale
methods.description: Returns the current zoom scale for the sheet view.

methods.name: setZoomScale
methods.description: Sets the zoom scale for the sheet view, validating that it is greater than or equal to 1.

methods.name: setZoomScaleNormal
methods.description: Sets the normal zoom scale, validating that it is greater than or equal to 1.

methods.name: setShowZeros
methods.description: Sets whether zeros should be shown as '0' in the worksheet.

methods.name: getView
methods.description: Returns the current sheet view type.

methods.name: setView
methods.description: Sets the sheet view type, validating that it is one of the allowed types.
